audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check passes: the Oluwadoro 2014 tone-system/syllable-structure passage is verbatim at pp.122-123 of the text we hold (lines 1956-2013) and the Oshodi 2011 sentence is on printed p.266 (PDF p.4); zero 'stress'/'accent' in both files re-verified. (2) The classification 'tonal (H/M/L, Yoruba-type), no stress rule described' rests on a 2014 comparative Akokoid article plus a 2011 Arigidi syntax/tone article, both open access, both by the two linguists who work on the language.
